provider: Ahrefs Keywords Explorer v3, country-scoped volume
why_this_measurement_exists: The market-scoped URL experiment found that every travel keyword in the en-AU and es-MX admission measurements names a place in that market's OWN country: all 54 Australian keywords name Australian places, all 27 Mexican keywords name Mexican places. So the experiment had no entity-level evidence either way about whether those markets search for FOREIGN destinations, and reporting 'no entity-specific demand' would have been a statement about the files rather than about the markets. This measurement settles it directly.
what_it_settles: Both markets have substantial, low-difficulty demand for foreign destinations. It does NOT settle whether a market-scoped page about one of those destinations would differ from the existing language-scoped page; that is a content question and the answer is recorded in MARKET-URL-EXPERIMENT.json.

keywords.keyword: things to do in new york
things to do in nusa penida

the_sources_this_demand_cannot_yet_be_tu.flight_routes_and_duration_from_the_orig: Sydney to Denpasar is six hours direct from six Australian cities. New York to Denpasar is not a comparable journey in any respect a reader plans around. This is the single strongest differentiator for en-AU and no captured source carries it.
the_sources_this_demand_cannot_yet_be_tu.origin_market_school_and_public_holiday_: the Australian summer holiday falls in December and January, which inverts when an Australian should visit Europe relative to a northern-hemisphere reader. The holiday layer carries holidays per country DESCRIBED, not per reader market.
the_sources_this_demand_cannot_yet_be_tu.per_passport_entry_rules: visa on arrival, length of stay and cost differ by the reader's passport. Nothing in this inventory is keyed on the reader's country.

note_on_the_totals: The two total_volume fields were first written by hand and were wrong: 46,600 against a real 44,700 for en-AU and 7,700 against 7,500 for es-MX. They are now the sum of their own keyword lists, which is the only total that can be checked.
